title: Abel-Ruffini: instantiate the general non-solvability statement at the quintic Φ 4 2
intent: Reduce the Abel-Ruffini theorem — there is an algebraic complex number not solvable by radicals — to instantiating the general non-solvability statement `not_solvable_by_rad`, proved for any p, a, b under the Eisenstein conditions, at the concrete quintic Φ ℚ 4 2, through the instantiation lemma `not_solvable_by_rad'` and three coefficient lemmas (`map_Phi`, `monic_Phi`, `degree_Phi`) that connect Φ 4 2 to the general family.
also_known_as: prove on a parameterised family, instantiate at the concrete case

parent.name: exists_not_solvable_by_rad
parent.statement: theorem exists_not_solvable_by_rad : ∃ x : ℂ, IsAlgebraic ℚ x ∧ x ∉ solvableByRad ℚ ℂ

children.name: not_solvable_by_rad'
children.statement: theorem not_solvable_by_rad' (x : ℂ) (hx : aeval x (Φ ℚ 4 2) = 0) : x ∉ solvableByRad ℚ ℂ
children.note: The instantiation lemma: applies the general not_solvable_by_rad at p = 2, a = 4, b = 2 and closes the Eisenstein side conditions (2.Prime, 2 ∣ 4, 2 ∣ 2, ¬4 ∣ 2, 2 < 4) by decide.

children.name: map_Phi
children.statement: theorem map_Phi {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) : (Φ R a b).map f = Φ S a b
children.note: Φ commutes with ring-homomorphism base change; used in the parent to transfer the complex root back to Φ ℚ 4 2.

children.name: monic_Phi
children.note: Φ is monic; used in the parent to give (Φ ℚ 4 2).ne_zero for the IsAlgebraic witness.

children.name: degree_Phi
children.statement: theorem degree_Phi : (Φ R a b).degree = ((5 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ)
children.closed_by: suffices degree (X ^ 5 - C (a : R) * X) = 5 by rwa [Φ, degree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt] · rw [degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt] <;> rw [degree_X_pow]
children.note: Φ has degree 5; used in the parent to show Φ ℂ 4 2 is non-constant so a complex root exists.

applicability.goal_shape: A headline existence statement ∃ x, P x about a concrete object (here a root of the quintic Φ ℚ 4 2) that is proved by instantiating a general theorem already proved for a parameterised family (not_solvable_by_rad over p, a, b under the Eisenstein conditions) plus coefficient facts that connect the concrete object to that family.
applicability.use_when: the general statement is already proved for a parameterised family with side conditions, and the concrete case only needs (a) an instantiation lemma that closes the side conditions by computation (not_solvable_by_rad' with <;> decide) and (b) coefficient lemmas establishing degree, monicity and base change, so the parent proof is pure instantiation with no new mathematics.
applicability.avoid_when: the side conditions of the general statement cannot be discharged by computation (then the instantiation lemma is itself substantial); the concrete object is not literally an instance of the general statement (then the connecting lemmas must be more than simp/rw); or the general statement is not already proved, in which case proving it is the real content and not the instantiation.

consequences: Creates four obligations beyond the headline statement: (1) a complex root of Φ ℂ 4 2 exists, discharged by IsAlgClosed.splits together with degree_Phi (degree 5, so non-constant); (2) that root is algebraic over ℚ, discharged by monic_Phi giving (Φ ℚ 4 2).ne_zero; (3) the root is rational-coefficient, transferred through map_Phi (the base change ℚ → ℂ) so the witness is a root of Φ ℚ 4 2; (4) the non-solvability comes from not_solvable_by_rad', which instantiates the general statement and must discharge its Eisenstein side conditions (p.Prime, p ∣ a, p ∣ b, ¬p² ∣ b, b < a at p=2, a=4, b=2) by decide. Failure modes: if the concrete a, b fail a side condition, decide fails and the instantiation lemma needs a real argument; if the polynomial is not monic, the IsAlgebraic witness loses its .ne_zero; if the base change is in the wrong direction, map_Phi does not apply.
